data.title: 阿米娅 · 舰桥休息室的小提琴休止符
data.action: 双手小心翼翼地将小提琴装入琴盒扣好锁扣，转过身来拢了拢睡裙边沿，长长的兔耳放松地微微下垂，眼眸里倒映着罗德岛的走廊暖光
data.location: 罗德岛陆行舰舰长生活区阿米娅的私人休息室
data.lighting: 休息室内柔和的顶棚暖白漫射光，映照着木质琴盒与棉麻睡衣的质朴纹理
data.mood: 治愈纯净、温婉舒缓、如同家人般的安心感
data.description: 夜深了，罗德岛甲板上的风暴渐渐平息。阿米娅刚结束今日的日常琴谱练习，换上了一件素雅的天蓝棉麻长款睡裙。她小心翼翼地把小提琴锁入琴盒，转过身看见走近的博士。两只修长的兔耳温柔地向后轻贴，她合拢手指放在胸前，棕色眼眸中盛满了纯粹的温暖——「博士，您还没有休息吗？……今天琴弦的声音很平稳，没有一丝焦躁。愿今晚罗德岛的所有人，都能做个好梦。」
data.promptProse: Amiya winds down after late violin practice in her private cabin aboard Rhodes Island. Having latched her dark violin case shut on the wooden desk, she turns toward the viewer with clasped hands and a gentle, unguarded smile. Soft warm ceiling light fills the quiet room and catches the woven texture of her pastel sky-blue cotton-linen nightdress and the polished wood of the case.
data.animaCaption: Having latched her violin case on the desk behind her, she turns in her pastel blue cotton nightdress with hands clasped at her chest and a calm smile. Warm overhead cabin lighting softens the quiet quarters around her.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a modest pastel sky-blue cotton-linen nightdress with a rounded lace collar, elbow-length sleeves, and soft waist drawstrings.
